newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see few trades in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see few trades in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained dull this afternoon as most buyers kept sidelined in anticipation of a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening, market sources said.

"Chicago soymeal futures closed limit-down on Friday on higher than expected USDA U.S. soybean crop and project A down as well most buyers decided to wait and see what Chicago would do this afternoon," one broker said.
Oct Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $280 a tonne cif Rotterdam and spot Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $162 a tonne fob.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
